scope.summary: Implement the typed Tailor interlink primitive DAG for character, sheet, evidence, BodyPose, BodyRecipe, garment, drape, and fit proposal workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Registers hsk.tailor.interlink_primitive_graph@1 with typed node/schema ids and ports, canonical graph hash, acyclic validation, pinned input versions, and per-node state/receipt lineage under the MT-710 hash law.

read_* returns verified pinned refs; derive_* emits immutable proposals/overlays; write_* calls the owning API with expected-base, lease, actor, event, ToolGate/capability, sandbox, PromotionGate, and validation checks and never mutates another subsystem's store directly.
Each node supports bounded cancellation, idempotency, retry, partial-failure state, outbox delivery, orphan recovery, and replay without losing the last accepted output.
ML-backed derivation replays a persisted immutable output or proves a named numerical envelope; replay never silently reruns a model.
Garment and fit nodes use MT-073 GarmentSpec and MT-312 fit orchestration authority; BodyPose and BodyRecipe commits use MT-520 and MT-605 authority; sheet links use MT-716 Atelier authority.

The immutable semantic payload is stored content-addressed in ArtifactStore and linked to an EventLedger event; interlink/store.rs persists only the typed authoritative ref plus transactional idempotency/query/outbox state, and list/get/replay reverify schema/content/source hashes without rerunning a model.
scope.risk_if_missed: An untyped or direct-write graph would bypass ownership, promotion, and recovery boundaries and make mixed character/pose/garment workflows non-replayable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior is observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; the owning native-shell MT verifies GUI projection.

target_entries: Tailor model manual > Read, derive, preview, and write primitives

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
